name: Compute Cluster S68: ML Full Coverage
description: Tests: lightgbm_classifier(boosting_type=dart/rf), lightgbm_regressor(boosting_type=dart/gbdt/rf), logistic_l1, logistic_l2, svr_l1, svr_l2, ml_zscore, ml_minmax, ml_robust. All ML algorithm and preprocessing variants.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S68: ML Full Coverage
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# === FEATURES ===
feat_mom = returns(period=21)(close)
feat_vol = volatility(close, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=21)
feat_rsi = rsi(close, 14)

# === TARGET ===
next_ret = returns(close) << 1
target_cls = next_ret > 0
target_reg = next_ret

# === ML PREPROCESSORS ===
feat_zs = ml_zscore(window_size=126)(feat_mom)
feat_mm = ml_minmax(window_size=126)(feat_mom)
feat_rb = ml_robust(window_size=126)(feat_mom)

# === LIGHTGBM CLASSIFIER: dart + rf (gbdt already covered in S68) ===
clf_dart = lightgbm_classifier(
    boosting_type=BoostingType.dart,
    num_estimators=50,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=15,
    min_data_in_leaf=50,
    window_size=126,
    step=21
)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target_cls)

clf_rf = lightgbm_classifier(
    boosting_type=BoostingType.rf,
    num_estimators=50,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=15,
    min_data_in_leaf=50,
    window_size=126,
    step=21
)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target_cls)

# === LIGHTGBM REGRESSOR: dart + gbdt + rf ===
reg_dart = lightgbm_regressor(
    boosting_type=BoostingType.dart,
    num_estimators=50,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=15,
    min_data_in_leaf=50,
    window_size=126,
    step=21
)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target_reg)

reg_gbdt = lightgbm_regressor(
    boosting_type=BoostingType.gbdt,
    num_estimators=50,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=15,
    min_data_in_leaf=50,
    window_size=126,
    step=21
)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target_reg)

reg_rf = lightgbm_regressor(
    boosting_type=BoostingType.rf,
    num_estimators=50,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=15,
    min_data_in_leaf=50,
    window_size=126,
    step=21
)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target_reg)

# === LOGISTIC REGRESSION ===
lr_l1 = logistic_l1(window_size=126, step=21)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target_cls)
lr_l2 = logistic_l2(window_size=126, step=21)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target_cls)

# === SVR ===
svr1 = svr_l1(window_size=126, step=21)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target_reg)
svr2 = svr_l2(window_size=126, step=21)(feat_mom, feat_vol, feat_rsi, target=target_reg)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='LightGBM Classifier: DART vs RF Probability',
    category='ML',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DART P(up)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RF P(up)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(clf_dart.probability, clf_rf.probability))

xy_lines(
    title='LightGBM Regressor: DART vs GBDT vs RF',
    category='ML',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DART', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GBDT', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RF', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(reg_dart.prediction, reg_gbdt.prediction, reg_rf.prediction))

xy_lines(
    title='ML Preprocessors: ZScore vs MinMax vs Robust',
    category='ML Preprocess',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZScore', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MinMax', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Robust', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(feat_zs, feat_mm, feat_rb))

xy_lines(
    title='Logistic L1 vs L2 Probability',
    category='ML',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='L1', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='L2', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(lr_l1.probability, lr_l2.probability))
